title: 第二章 开袋见宝
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
狗叫声从东边传过来，比刚才近了些。

    猴子站起来，没往下游跑，往上游走。下游水缓，脚印不容易散；上游水急，踩过的石头转眼就被水抹平。在岳州城躲官差搜人的时候，他就蹚过城河，从桥底下钻过去，狗在岸上转了一宿也没闻着他。

    走了半里地，溪沟分了岔。左边往崖壁方向，地势高，碎石多；右边往下游，水缓林密。他选了左边。碎石上不容易留脚印。

    他在岔路口的泥地上踩了几个清晰的脚印，方向朝着右边。又蹲下来，用手在左边的碎石路上拨拉了几下，把石子拨得更乱。自己踩着乱石堆往上走，每走一步都回头看一眼，脚印在碎石上根本看不出来。

    到了崖壁底下，他蹲下去，把溪底的烂泥重新涂了一遍。脸上、脖子上、手腕上，全涂满，只露出两只眼睛。烂泥里混着腐烂的树叶和苔藓，闻起来跟沼泽地似的。

    岳州城的猎户打猎前都往身上抹烂泥。野兽闻不着人味，狗也一样。刘管事的狼狗虽然凶，但不是猎户养的猎犬，没训过怎么分辨烂泥和人味。

    他蹲在崖壁底下不动。追兵的狗叫从岔路口方向传过来。两条狗同时叫，方向不一样，一条往矮松那边，一条往碎石坡这边。还有一队人原地没动，应该在岔路口守着。

    猴子从地上捡了块拳头大的石头，掂了掂，往右边矮松方向扔过去。石头砸在树干上，弹了一下，滚进枯叶堆里，哗啦啦一串响。

    两条狗同时对着那边狂吠。

    “在那边！”有人喊。猴子一听原来是王府那个猥琐的刘管事。

    脚步声、狗叫声一起往矮松方向涌。猴子趁这功夫从崖壁侧面滑下去，钻进一片矮松林，从另一头绕出来，踩着碎石往高处走。等追兵的狗还在矮松那边转，他已经翻过崖壁，往更深的老林子里钻了。

    崖壁侧面有道窄缝，刚好能挤进去。他扯了几根藤蔓把缝遮住，蹲在里面听。

    追兵在矮松那边搜了大半个时辰。狗叫声慢慢远了。

    猴子从缝里钻出来，顺着崖壁继续往上，翻过山脊，下到另一侧的河谷。

    狗叫听不见了。只剩溪水声和风声。

    他在溪边蹲下来，灌了几口凉水，把脸上干掉的烂泥洗了，重新涂了一层湿的。追兵今晚应该不会再折回来。但他知道，天一亮还得接着跑。

    “小石头，饿了一天了，比在岳州城还惨呀，你得保佑我逃过一劫哦。”

    猴子胡乱搞了点野果充饥，也不管苦涩得要吐。

    “妈的，这帮狗腿子，追了老子整整一天！”他啐了一口，嘴里碎碎念，“小石头，你哥这条命，差点就交代在这山里了。”

    他找了处背风的巨石，瘫坐在上面歇脚，抬头一看，才发现天已经彻底黑透了。
content_en:
The sound of dogs barking came from the east, closer than before.

    The monkey stood up and walked upstream instead of running downstream. The water downstream is slow, so the footprints are not easily scattered; the water upstream is fast, and the stones stepped on are smoothed away by the water in the blink of an eye. When he was hiding from officials in Yuezhou City to search for people, he waded across the city river and got under the bridge. The dog wandered on the bank all night without smelling him.

    After walking for half a mile, the creek branched. To the left toward the cliff, the terrain is high and there are many gravels; to the right toward the downstream, the water is slow and the forest is dense. He chose the left. It is not easy to leave footprints on gravel.

    He stepped on a few clear footprints on the mud at the fork in the road, heading to the right. He squatted down again and plucked the gravel road on the left a few times with his hands, making the stones even more chaotic. I stepped on the rubble and walked up, looking back every step I took. The footprints were not visible at all on the rubble.

    When he reached the bottom of the cliff, he squatted down and re-smeared the mud at the bottom of the stream. The face, neck, and wrists were all covered, leaving only two eyes exposed. The mud was mixed with rotting leaves and moss and smelled like a swamp.

    Hunters in Yuezhou City smear mud on themselves before hunting. Wild animals cannot smell humans, and neither can dogs. Although Guanshi Liu's wolfdog is fierce, it is not a hunting dog raised by hunters. It has not been trained to distinguish between mud and human smell.

    He squatted at the bottom of the cliff without moving. The barking of the pursuing soldiers came from the direction of the fork in the road. Two dogs barked at the same time, in different directions. One was heading toward the dwarf pine trees, and the other was heading toward the gravel slope. There is still a group of people who are still standing and should be guarding the fork in the road.

    The monkey picked up a fist-sized stone from the ground, weighed it, and threw it toward the dwarf pine on the right. The stone hit the tree trunk, bounced, and rolled into the pile of dead leaves, making a series of clattering sounds.

    Two dogs barked at the same time.

    "Over there!" someone shouted. When the monkey heard it, it turned out to be the wretched manager Liu of the palace.

    The sound of footsteps and the barking of dogs rushed toward the dwarf pine. The monkey took advantage of this moment to slide down the side of the cliff, got into a dwarf pine forest, came out from the other end, and walked to higher ground on the gravel. While the chasing dogs were still circling around the dwarf pine trees, he had climbed over the cliff and penetrated deeper into the old forest.

    There is a narrow gap on the side of the cliff, just enough to squeeze through. He pulled a few vines to cover the gap and squatted inside to listen.

    The pursuers searched Dwarf Pine for most of an hour. The barking of the dog slowly faded away.

    The monkey emerged from the crack and continued up the cliff, over the ridge and down to the valley on the other side.

    The barking of the dog could not be heard. Only the sound of the stream and the wind were left.

    He squatted down by the stream, drank a few mouthfuls of cold water, washed the dried mud off his face, and applied a new layer of wet mud. The pursuers should not turn back tonight. But he knew that he would have to keep running as soon as daylight came.

    "Little Shitou, I've been hungry all day. It's worse than in Yuezhou City. You have to protect me from this disaster."

    The monkey randomly ate some wild fruits to satisfy his hunger, but he didn't care that they were so bitter that he would vomit.

    "Damn, these bastards have been chasing me all day!" He spat and muttered, "Little Shitou, your brother's life was almost decided in this mountain."

    He found a boulder leeward and sat down on it to rest. When he looked up, he realized that it was completely dark.
title_en: Chapter 2: Open the bag and find the treasure
